core_rules.description: Never execute breakout expansion lot sizing inside a rotational range. Identify Value Area High (VAH) and Value Area Low (VAL). If price oscillates within VAH-VAL without volume displacement, treat every boundary move as mean-reverting absorption, fading extremes back toward POC.
core_rules.execution_action: Disqualify momentum breakout triggers; require boundary rejection candle at VAH or VAL before entry.

core_rules.description: Once price confirms aggressive displacement in our favor and achieves +1.0R open profit, immediately ratchet Stop Loss to Entry Price + spread (0R). Winning trades must never be allowed to reverse into full losses.

When price hits the designated daily structural target wall and daily/session realized profit reaches +3.0R, immediately close remaining runners and stop trading for the session. Prevent giving back profits through overtrading during late-session low-liquidity churn.

A true directional trend is strictly defined by One-Time Framing. Bullish One-Time Framing requires each higher timeframe candle to print a Higher High, Higher Low, and Higher Close. Any candle printing a lower low immediately pauses directional expansion bias.
core_rules.algorithmic_trigger: high[t] > high[t-1] and low[t] > low[t-1] and close[t] > close[t-1]
core_rules.execution_action: Enforce trend alignment on H4/H1; disqualify counter-trend trades when HTF is one-time framing.

core_rules.description: Measure ATR_14 contraction vs expansion. When volatility compresses below 0.6x historical average, reduce position sizing by 30% and tighten target expectations; when volatility expands into extreme tails (> 2.5x ATR_14), demand wider structural stops and adjust lot size downward to maintain fixed dollar risk.

Never chase a market that departs impulsively without retesting the structural origin. If price leaves a high-probability demand/supply zone without filling our limit order, cancel the entry order rather than market-executing at degraded risk-to-reward.

When H4 structure exhibits clean liquidity sweeps and aligns with weekly bias, do not scalp out early for trivial 0.5R profits. Hold runners toward major opposing liquidity pools across multiple 4-hour sessions (holding 1 to 5 days).
Identify unmitigated equal highs (EQH) and equal lows (EQL) as high-probability magnet zones. Market structure moves deliberately toward resting liquidity before executing real reversal displacement.
core_rules.execution_action: Anchor TP1 directly into resting liquidity pool.

core_rules.description: If a trade remains stagnant inside the entry zone without achieving +0.5R or invalidation within 6 holding cycles (24 hours), market dynamics have shifted from expansion to decay. Close position at market to preserve emotional and risk capital.
